newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville cuts Tues peak-hour power prices $1/MWh.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville cuts Tues peak-hour power prices $1/MWh.

text.p: Bonneville Power Administration Monday lowered its prices for daily surplus firm power during hours on Tuesday by one dollar per megawatt hours.

Price offers for Tuesday from the federal power marketing agency were $13.00 during hours 0100-0600 and 2400 PDT, $17.00 during hours 0700-1200 and 2200-2300 PDT, and $19.00 during hours 1300-2100 PDT.
For Monday, BPA offered firm power at $13.00 for off-peak hours 0100-0600 and 2400 PDT; $18.00 during hours 0700-0900 and 2200-2300 PDT, and $20.00 for 1000-2100 PDT.
